description: This file defines the class TransactionBoundCacheManager, which implements cache management with transaction lifecycle awareness by implementing TransactionLifecycleCallback and wrapping another CacheManager.

classes.name: TransactionBoundCacheManager
classes.description: A cache manager that clears caches after transaction begin and completion, wrapping an underlying CacheManager.

methods.name: afterCompletion
methods.description: Clears all caches after transaction completion.

methods.name: afterBegin
methods.description: Clears all caches at the start of a transaction.

methods.name: resetCaches
methods.description: Retrieves all cache names and clears each cache if it exists.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns the cache by name from the delegate CacheManager.

methods.name: getCacheNames
methods.description: Returns the collection of cache names from the delegate CacheManager.
